subject: Request to temporarily restore sandbox + trial credits for NimbusWorks POC
messages:
From: Samantha Liu <samantha.liu@nimbuswork.io>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Sandbox reactivation request — urgent for POC finish

Hi Karthik,

We were ramping up a small POC with Redwood last month but our sandbox credits expired mid-test. That cut our evaluation short — we still need another ~200k tokens and a couple days of continuous testing to finalize latency/throughput numbers for Infra.

Can Redwood temporarily restore the sandbox (same tenant) for 30 days and issue a one-time 200k-token top-up so we can complete the benchmark? Procurement has asked for a short note confirming there will be no billing for the restored credits so they can sign off quickly.

I attached a one-page summary of what we need and the target tests (POC_requirements.pdf). Our timeline is tight — procurement needs confirmation by EOD Wednesday PT to meet our internal review next week.

Thanks,
Samantha Liu
Senior Platform Engineer, NimbusWorks
samantha.liu@nimbuswork.io
+1 (415) 555-0198

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Liu <samantha.liu@nimbuswork.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Sandbox reactivation request — urgent for POC finish

Hi Samantha — thanks for the details and the attachment. We can usually handle temporary restores for active evaluations, but I need a quick approvals path internally for a 200k-token grant and the "no billing" note for procurement.

I've looped in Marissa (revenue ops) and Aditya (finance) to confirm the credit topology and any limits on one-off grants. Can you confirm the exact tenant id and the preferred start date? If you want, we can make the reset effective immediately and give you 30 days from the restore.

If procurement needs a formal statement, we can provide a short PDF that says: "Redwood Inference will provision a one-time, non-billable sandbox credit top-up of 200k tokens for NimbusWorks to support a 30-day POC from the restore date." I can draft that once I have approvals.

-Karthik
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
kal: 415-xxx-xxxx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 11:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Sandbox reactivation request — internal approval

Karthik / Aditya — quick internal note:

I reviewed the NimbusWorks activity and their account history. They did a reasonable ingest and test matrix; this looks like a genuine POC restart ask and a good opportunity for expansion if they get the numbers. Approve a one-time 200k-token sandbox top-up and 30-day restore. No invoice should be generated for the top-up.

Please include a short procurement-facing statement (one line + timeframe) and require a confirmation email from the NimbusWorks procurement alias (procurement@nimbuswork.io) before we flip the switch. Also add a note in the deal record (NW-POC-2026-7892) indicating this is a one-off courtesy.

Marissa
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Liu <samantha.liu@nimbuswork.io>, procurement@nimbuswork.io
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 08:47:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Sandbox reactivation request — confirmation & next steps

Samantha / Procurement team —

Thanks for the patience. Per internal approval, Redwood will: 
- Restore the existing sandbox tenant for NimbusWorks immediately.
- Provision a one-time, non-billable credit top-up of 200,000 tokens.
- Grant 30 days from the restore timestamp; the account will revert to normal billing thereafter unless a paid agreement is in place.

Procurement: please confirm via reply to this thread that you accept the above so we have a written record. Once we see confirmation, engineering will run the reset and I will send a short PDF confirmation you can attach to your internal purchase file.

Restore link/console: https://console.redwood.ai/sandbox/restore/REQ-7892
DocuSign (if you later want sign-off): https://docusign.net/Docs/abc123

Attached: reset-instructions.txt (sample curl + token usage guidance).

Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai

From: Samantha Liu <samantha.liu@nimbuswork.io>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@nimbuswork.io
Date: Fri, 3 Dec 2026 17:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Sandbox reactivation request — confirmation & next steps

Karthik — thanks, confirmed from procurement side. We accept the 30-day one-time, non-billable 200k-token top-up as described. Please proceed with the restore when you have a minute.

I'll reply after we complete the throughput tests with any follow-up questions. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

—Samantha

Senior Platform Engineer, NimbusWorks
